# Security

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report it privately through [GitHub's security advisories](https://github.com/kubehenge/cluster-api-control-plane-provider-talos/security/advisories/new), never in a public issue, discussion or pull request. If you cannot use GitHub, write to [security@kubehenge.dev](mailto:security@kubehenge.dev). Include what is affected, how to reproduce it, and what an attacker gains.

You will get an answer within a week. We confirm the problem, agree a disclosure date with you (normally within 90 days, sooner for anything actively exploited), fix it in a release, and publish an advisory crediting you unless you would rather not be named.

Vulnerabilities in Talos Linux itself or in Cluster API go to those projects.

## Supported versions

Fixes go into the newest release.
